groups.title: Real Estate Product
groups.meta: Flutter, Clean Architecture, Scrum, Kanban · Team size: 20 mobile devs
bullets: Built and maintained features for a Saudi Arabian government client's real estate product; analysed BRDs with BA, backend and QC, agreed API implementation, estimated tasks and delivered on time.
Demoed features to the client after every epic; reviewed code and supported team members.
Integrated third-party SDKs and embedded Unity into Flutter for an in-app metaverse of buildings and events.
Reduced app size from 200MB to 90MB and raised key screens from 30–40 FPS to a steady 60 by removing unnecessary re-renders.
Optimised data-layer caching and migrated state management from Stream to BLoC.
Implemented SSL pinning and set up Adjust deferred deep links.

groups.title: Cocototo – virtual pet game
groups.meta: Flutter, Flame, Firebase · Team size: 2 mobile devs
bullets: Took the game from an empty repository to release.
Worked across every layer: architecture, Flame game loop, gameplay state, Firebase backend, UI and release, reporting directly to the client in Japan.

groups.title: Warehouse App for POS / Handheld Devices
groups.meta: Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, MVVM, Clean Architecture · Team size: 4 mobile devs
bullets: Built a warehouse management app for Unitech HT300/HT330 barcode devices, end to end.
Integrated the hardware scanner for real-time barcode capture; handled goods receipt, dispatch and inventory updates over REST API.
Built an offline-first data layer with periodic sync, so the floor kept working without a network.
Drove cross-team agreement on barcode formats; implemented auto-launch on reboot and published the app privately on Google Play.

groups.title: Cross-Platform Apps
groups.meta: Flutter, React Native · Team size: 4–6 mobile devs
bullets: Built new apps and maintained existing ones across booking, e-learning, file management and apartment equipment.
Led a sub-project with 3 members: planned sprints, estimated tasks and reviewed delivery.
Integrated VNPAY, FCM and Firebase Crashlytics.

note.label: Also:
note.text: Maintained admin dashboards and academy websites in React.js and Next.js, with 3D UI components in Three.js. Agile throughout: system design, API contracts and QA triage.
